policy.question: Can a fixed Gemma K01 configuration construct a minimal valid DAG when its terminal rule is externally designated?
policy.intervention: Fix the common k03/k17/k10 rule array and replace the historical merged instruction/schema with a common conditional minimal-DAG task; only the target rule ID varies.
policy.sampling: All 10 historical seeds; four dependent observations per seed, not 40 independent problems.
policy.schedule: SHA256-ranked seeds; five ABBA and five BAAB blocks, frozen schedule_seed=6202026.
policy.history: No state reset. Same-condition repeat distance and preceding calls remain possible explanations.
policy.interpretation: This is conditional construction after a target is supplied. It does not test free terminal selection, depth-direction following, A control, M1/M2 review, an internal mechanism, or general depth control.
policy.measurement: Format, proof validity, strict ancestry closure, final-goal reach, target-rule match, actual parent-D, rule position/rank, node count and target fulfillment are separate.
policy.gate: Only complete 40/40 strict-valid target matches with k03 D=1, k17 D=2 and all ten seed profiles stable may motivate a separately frozen free-choice minimal-DAG design.
policy.missing: Unobserved and unmeasured remain null; full rates require complete measured denominators.
policy.budget: 40 inference calls and 20 metadata records; no warmup.
